items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude 3.7 Sonnet
items.summary: Anthropic describes Claude 3.7 Sonnet as its first hybrid reasoning model, able to answer directly or use visible extended thinking with a budget of up to 128K tokens, and reports 70.3% on SWE-bench Verified with high compute. It launched alongside Claude Code as a limited research preview, at $3/$15 per million input/output tokens.
